import random, sys, json, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gen, para, algo
rng=random.Random(2024)
stats={'incons':0,'nosafe':0,'safe':0,'warm>0':0}
for it in range(400):
    prof=gen.gen_profile(rng)
    cal=para.build_calib(prof)
    fb=gen.gen_fabric(rng, cal.K if cal.feasible else 2, maxP=12)
    plan=algo.compile_plan(prof, fb)
    if plan['status']!='ok': stats['incons']+=1; continue
    if plan['guard_ns'] is None: stats['nosafe']+=1
    else:
        stats['safe']+=1
        if plan['warmup_cycle']>0: stats['warm>0']+=1
    assert algo.audit(prof,fb,plan)['valid'], json.dumps(fb)
print(stats)
PYEOF
